subject: Reconciling VPC license amortization and multi-site concessions
messages:
From: Elena Morris <elena.morris@medisys.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@medisys.com>, Medisys Legal <legal@medisys.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 16:23:00 -0400
Subject: Questions on platform fee amortization + multi-site discount

Sergio — thanks for the conversation earlier. We reviewed your private deployment proposal and have two open items from procurement and engineering before we can move to legal:

1) Platform fee amortization: Medisys typically capitalizes platform fees over 12–24 months. Your proposal referenced a "platform fee" that looks front-loaded. Can you share options for amortizing this across a 24-month term (or equivalently provide a staged credit schedule)?

2) Multi-site / node pricing: We plan to run Redwood in 3 hospital regions (three identical VPC clusters). Would you be able to offer a per-node discount or a multi-site concession if we commit to all three at once?

We attached our VPC requirements doc. Procurement has also asked for a preliminary term sheet we can review with finance.

Next steps: please send a short counterproposal (pricing scenarios) and a sample term sheet we can circulate.

Best,
Elena Morris
Head of Cloud Engineering, Medisys Health
Elena.Morris@medisys.com
Attachment: Medisys_vpc_requirements.pdf

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morris <elena.morris@medisys.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Questions on platform fee amortization + multi-site discount

Elena — thanks for the clear ask and the requirements doc. Quick answers and an initial proposal outline below. I attached an initial term sheet for procurement to review.

High level options (we can mix + match):
- Amortization path: 24-month amortization with an upfront platform fee + monthly credits. Option A: 100% amortized (monthly credits equal to platform fee / 24). Option B: 50/50 split (50% upfront, 50% amortized).
- Multi-site concession: for a 3-site commit we can offer either (i) a 12% per-node discount across all three clusters, or (ii) a larger platform fee credit (equal to 1 month of platform fee per additional site) if you prefer to keep per-node list price.
- Support tiers: Standard (8x5, 4hr P1 response) / Business (24x7, 2hr P1) / Enterprise (24x7, 1hr + named SLA). We recommend Business for production hospital clusters.

Proposed quick scenario (for budgeting):
- 24-month term, 3 clusters committed, Business support
- Platform fee: $300k upfront, amortized over 24 months. With a 12% per-node discount the blended effective platform run-rate reduces ~18% over list.
- If you prefer amortization credits instead of list discount, we can convert $36k (12%) into monthly credits applied to invoices.

Attachments: initial_term_sheet_v1.pdf (price tables + support definitions).

Next steps: Olga, can you run a quick margin check on the 12% node discount and confirm any engineering caveats? Rishi, flag anything from legal/ops that would block a 24-month amortization with credits. Elena — if this looks directionally right, we can turn the term sheet into a redline-ready version for Medisys legal.

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
Attachment: initial_term_sheet_v1.pdf

From: Elena Morris <elena.morris@medisys.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@medisys.com>, Medisys Legal <legal@medisys.com>
Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 13:08:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Questions on platform fee amortization + multi-site discount

Sergio — thanks, this is helpful. A couple of follow-ups from finance & procurement:

- Finance preference: 18–24 month amortization is acceptable, but they asked whether Redwood would consider a deeper platform fee credit in lieu of per-node discount (they prefer credits applied against invoice rather than changing SKU prices). That helps our internal accounting.
- Procurement ask: if we commit to 3 sites for 36 months, can you provide a stepped credit schedule (higher credit year 1, tapering year 2–3)?

We're attaching an internal budget note to show how they plan to treat credits vs. discounts.

If you can propose two concrete priced scenarios (24-month with credits; 36-month with stepped credits), we'll circulate to legal next week.

Best,
Elena
Attachment: internal_budget_note.xlsx

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morris <elena.morris@medisys.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 11:30:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Questions on platform fee amortization + multi-site discount

Elena / Sergio — ran the numbers with finance. A few notes and a recommended counter that balances Medisys's accounting preferences with our margin constraints:

Counterproposal (concrete):
- 24-month scenario (preferred for Redwood economics):
  • Platform fee: $280,000 upfront
  • Applied credit schedule: $11,666 / month for 24 months (equivalent to full amortization as credits)
  • Per-node discount: 10% across all 3 clusters (applies to runtime units only)
  • Support: Business tier ($35k/yr per cluster) — includes 24x7 P1 escalation and quarterly on-call review
  • Rationale: credits keep your finance treatment simpler; 10% per-node keeps our unit economics viable.

- 36-month stepped scenario (procurement preference):
  • Platform fee: $300,000 upfront
  • Year 1 credit: $24k/month applied to invoices (higher concession to help go-live)
  • Years 2–3 credit: $8k/month
  • Per-node discount: 8%
  • Support: Business with a 10% managed-services discount if you prepay 36 months

Operational caveats:
- We need a final node count by May 28 to lock pricing (we price by committed concurrent nodes).
- Any change to sequence length or expected peak traffic that increases GPU profile may require a revision to the per-node pricing.

Related link: term sheet draft (for legal) — https://drive.redwood.com/teams/sergio/vpc-term-sheet-v1

If that aligns, Sergio / I can produce a redline-ready term sheet and a DocuSign-ready file for signatures.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Head of Commercial Ops — Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morris <elena.morris@medisys.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 16:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Questions on platform fee amortization + multi-site discount

Elena — appreciate the fast turnaround. Legal has reviewed Olga's counter and is comfortable proceeding with the 24-month credits approach subject to two standard clauses: audit rights for usage reporting and an SLA appendix that mirrors our Business support metrics.

Final commercial offer (what we'll put into the term sheet for signature):
- 24-month term, commit to 3 clusters (confirmed node counts to be finalized in SOW)
- Platform fee: $280,000 upfront + $11,666/mo credit applied against invoices for 24 months
- 10% per-node discount on runtime charges
- Business support for each cluster as defined in appendix (24x7 P1, 2hr response)
- Trial clause: 90-day go-live review with the option to convert to a managed-services retainer at a pre-agreed rate

I've uploaded the final term sheet / signature bundle here: https://docusign.com/placeholder/RDW-2026-057 (DocuSign package includes redline and SOW placeholder). Attachment: redwood_vpc_final_term_sheet.pdf

If Medisys is aligned, Elena — can you confirm preferred signers (procurement + CFO) and target signature date? We'll aim to have DocuSign live by Fri, May 21.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
VP, Legal & Commercial — Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood_vpc_final_term_sheet.pdf
